hint: Requires AutoJs6 6.8.0 (a development build from 2026-10-15 or later, or a stable build, with build number 5352 or higher); earlier development builds also numbered 5352 do not meet this requirement

Hosts without protocol v24 ignore all of this plugin's file manager actions, including viewing an image, viewing selected images, browsing a folder as an album, editing, conversion and batch conversion

An overwrite can be undone once, from its notice: when editing or converting in this app, a backup of the original is kept until the next overwrite (images over 256 MiB warn first that undo is not possible); when editing or converting from the AutoJs6 file manager, undo is available for 8 seconds
feature: Redesigned editor: the top bar has Undo, Redo, Compare (hold to show the original) and Save; tools are grouped into Transform, Adjust, Filters, Draw, Annotate and Text; the canvas can be zoomed with two fingers and dragged
Filters: 14 of them (such as Mono, Sepia, Vintage, Film, Fade), with adjustable intensity, and they combine with adjustments
Adjust adds Exposure, Hue, Highlights, Shadows, Sharpen and Vignette
Transform adds Resize: by percentage, by long edge or to a custom width and height (with locked aspect ratio)
Annotate: rectangles, ellipses, arrows and lines, drawn by dragging on the image, then moved and resized; rectangles and ellipses can be outlined or filled
Long-press the canvas to pick a color: a magnifier shows the pixels under your finger and the color value, which becomes the brush and annotation color when you lift
Saving offers Overwrite the original (off by default) and Keep capture details (camera, date and exposure settings; location is always removed), and shows the file name that will be saved

Rotated images can be saved from the viewer: JPEG only gets a new orientation tag and is not recompressed; PNG and WebP are re-encoded. This can be turned off in Settings > Viewer > Offer to save rotations
The converter uses the same settings layout as batch conversion, and it can overwrite the original too

From the AutoJs6 file manager: Edit image and Convert image can overwrite the original; View image can delete the opened or selected images, which go to the AutoJs6 Trash and can be restored with Undo (other images of the folder reached by swiping cannot be deleted)
fix: "Edit image" and "Convert image" missing from image files' "More" menus in the AutoJs6 file manager
On Android 15, renaming or deleting images on a storage card asked for a system confirmation, even for images saved by this app

hint: Batch conversion from the AutoJs6 file manager needs an AutoJs6 version with a More button in its selection bar, which the released AutoJs6 versions do not have yet; until then, convert in batches from the albums of this plugin
feature: Batch conversion: select images in an album and choose More > Convert to convert them all with one set of settings (format, quality, original size / percentage / long edge, clockwise rotation, JPEG background for transparency, whether to keep safe EXIF data)

Batch-converted images are saved next to their originals as <name>_converted and never replace them; albums that Android does not let apps add images to (such as Download) save into a folder of the same name under Pictures

A batch shows its progress and can be cancelled at any time (the image being converted is saved completely or not at all); images that could not be converted are listed with the reason and can be retried with the same settings
In the AutoJs6 file manager, Convert images works on selected images: the new images are saved next to the originals, and only when every image converts, so a failure leaves no new file
fix: After opening an image from an album, the next or previous image sometimes kept loading, and Print stayed unavailable

hint: Hiding an album puts a .nomedia file into its folder, so other gallery apps no longer show its images either (nothing is deleted); on Android 11 and later it needs All files access first. To leave an album out of this gallery only, use Exclude

Exclude only affects this gallery: excluded albums disappear from the album list, all images, favorites and search, the files on the device stay as they are, and Settings > Excluded folders brings them back
feature: Multi-select in the album list: long-press an album to pin, exclude, hide, delete whole albums (to the recycle bin, with undo) or rename an album
Pinned albums come right after Favorites, before the other albums, with a pin mark
Settings > Hidden folders lists hidden folders and shows them again, and can list them at the end of the album list (browse and share only)

Sorting moves to a dialog: random order and groups by day or by month (the group title stays at the top), optionally for the current album only; the album list sorts by name, date modified, date taken or number of images and remembers it
Search: the home screen searches album names and file names, and an opened image pages through the results; inside an album the search filters by file name
fix: Moving an image from a storage card into an album on the internal storage (or the other way round) left it on its old storage, in another album with the same name, and copies always went to the internal storage; both now land in the chosen album

On Android 7-10 deleting, moving or renaming images on a storage card could leave copies behind or create stray folders on the internal storage; these versions do not let apps change a storage card, so such images now stay as they are with a message

hint: Deleted images go to a recycle bin first: on Android 11+ the system's (other gallery apps see it too), cleared by the system after about 30 days; on Android 7-10 the app's own, kept for 30 days and using at most a tenth of the free space (up to 2 GiB), removed together with the app. It can be switched off in Settings > Recycle bin; deleting then asks first and cannot be undone

On Android 11+ the system confirms each batch that deletes, moves or renames images saved by other apps; turning on Media management (Android 12+) in Settings > Storage permission removes these confirmations
feature: The image grid supports multi-select: long press an image to start, tap to add or remove, keep the finger down after the long press and drag to select a range (the grid scrolls near the top or bottom), select all or invert; share, favorite, move, copy or delete several images at once, rename one or show details
A deletion can be undone from the bar at the bottom; the home screen menu gains Recycle bin, which shows the days left for each image and restores, deletes forever or empties

Move and copy offer an album or a new album in Pictures, with recently used albums first; when the target already has images with the same names they ask once: keep both (a number is added to the new name), skip, or replace (the existing images go to the recycle bin); batches show progress and can be cancelled; moving and renaming can be undone
Favorites: favorite images are gathered in the Favorites album at the top of the album list; on Android 11+ Sync system favorites in Settings lets other gallery apps see them
Opened from an album, the viewer gains a heart button in the top bar, and Delete replaces Open with in the bottom bar; Open with, Rename, Move and Copy are in the top right menu
Images in authorized folders can be deleted (for good, after a confirmation, without the recycle bin) and renamed
dependency: Added Room 2.8.1 to keep the favorites and the Android 7-10 recycle bin records

hint: Launched on its own, the app asks once for photo access (photos and videos on Android 13+, storage on older versions) to show your albums; if you refuse it never asks again by itself, viewing, editing and converting keep working through the system picker, and you can grant access later from the home screen or Settings > Storage permission. Opening images from AutoJs6 or other apps never asks for any permission
feature: The home screen becomes an album view: images on the device grouped by folder (cover, name, count), or a flat view of all folder contents; the image grid offers 3-6 columns (menu or pinch), sorting by name, date modified, date taken or size remembered per album, a fast scroller with a date hint and pull to refresh
The viewer pages through the whole album with left and right swipes, a thumbnail strip jumps to a page on tap, and the grid returns to the last image viewed
Rotate an image with two fingers; it snaps to the nearest quarter turn on release, changes the display only, can be undone and can be turned off in Settings > Viewer

A new Storage permission page in Settings shows the current access, grants it again, manages selected photos on Android 14+, adds or removes authorized folders (shown as albums even without photo access) and offers the optional All files access
The folder menu of the AutoJs6 file manager gains View as album, which shows the folder's images as a grid and opens its subfolders
dependency: Added Navigation Compose 2.10.2 for navigation between the home screen and album pages

hint: The APK now carries libandroidx.graphics.path.so, a native library bundled with Jetpack Compose (about 10 KB each for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 and x86); the plugin itself still contains no native code and remains one universal APK
The first few launches after installation are a little slower on older devices until the system finishes its background optimization
feature: The whole interface moves to Material 3 (Jetpack Compose): home, settings, about, release history, viewer, editor and converter are rebuilt, follow the theme color and dark mode, and support large fonts and right-to-left layouts
The editor toolbar becomes grouped tool strips with icons and labels (transform, adjust, draw, text); the parameter panel follows the active tool, and the text, save and palette dialogs are rebuilt
The converter turns from a dialog into a full page form that shows only the inputs of the current resize mode, with the output resolution, estimated size and suffix pinned at the bottom
The viewer bottom bar now offers Details, Rotate, Edit, Share and Open with; images opened from the standalone home or from another app can go straight to the editor and save the result
fix: The in-app release history page was blank (the ## version headings of the generated file were not recognized)
After switching the app language to Arabic, pages that were already open kept a left-to-right layout
In light mode the status bar icons of the viewer and editor followed the page theme and turned dark, so they were invisible over the dark canvas
improvement: Plugin Center icons use the sizes, positions, light and dark artwork, and circular backgrounds adjusted in Icon Studio, retaining reproducible sources and parameters
Android App info icons share Icon Studio artwork and light/dark backgrounds while preserving transparent Plugin Center artwork and existing launcher choices
Icons are unified as Material 24 dp vectors; bitmap icons and unused color, style and string resources are removed
A built-in startup baseline profile lowers the home cold start cost of the interface migration once the system has run its background optimization
dependency: Added Jetpack Compose BOM 2026.09.00 for the user interface migration
Added the Glide Compose integration 1.0.0-beta10 for image loading in Compose screens
Upgraded the AutoJs6 Gradle Platform Versions and Native Alignment plugins 1.9.0 -> 1.9.1

hint: The application ID changes from io.github.supermonster003.autojs6.plugin.imageviewer / io.github.supermonster003.autojs6.plugin.imagetools to io.github.supermonster003.autojs6.plugin.three.maple.image. Android installs this as a separate app; existing apps and data can remain, and settings are not migrated automatically
feature: Image Viewer and Image Tools are combined in 3-Maple Image, with viewing, editing and format conversion in one app
A standalone home screen opens local images, starts editing or conversion, and saves the result to a chosen destination
Language, dark mode, theme color and four launcher icon choices are available in the shared settings layout

improvement: Raise compileSdk and targetSdk to 37 (Android 17); the plugin's behavior does not depend on the new target
fix: SDK XML v4 parsing warnings with AGP 9.1 and APK native alignment checks incorrectly triggered by JVM unit-test assembly tasks, using shared build plugins 1.8.3

feature: Local release history is available from the interface, with localized text and an English fallback
improvement: Release packages are checked for a complete signing configuration, exact APK contents and reproducible documentation

feature: Redesigned the viewer as an immersive full-bleed screen: the image now fills the whole window under the status and navigation bars, and the top and bottom bars are translucent overlays that hide or return with a single tap
Overlay title bar with the file name, a `3 / 12` style page counter while browsing a folder or a selection, and a top-right menu hosting `Reset zoom` and `Print / Save PDF`
Bottom action bar with icon buttons for `Details`, `Rotate`, `Share`, and `Open with`, plus a floating pause / resume button that appears only for animated GIFs
Image details now open in a draggable bottom sheet with the file name, MIME type, size, resolution, decoded color information, and EXIF fields; swipe down, tap the image, or press back to close it
improvement: Edge-to-edge system bar and display cutout handling, so the layout stays fully visible on Android 15 and later instead of being covered by system bars
Every icon control carries an accessibility description matching its former text label
Build verification rejects accidental native dependencies and produces a JSON report

hint: AutoJs6 host build 5276 or later is required for explorer-action v12 same-folder browsing and explicit multi-selection
feature: Browse supported images in the same folder by swiping in natural filename order, or open an explicit selection of up to 128 images while preserving the host selection order
Enhanced viewer gestures with focal pinch zoom, 2.5x double-tap zoom, 90-degree view rotation, a transient zoom indicator and pause/resume controls for animated GIFs

On-demand EXIF details with automatic correction of all 8 orientation variants and hidden GPS coordinates, plus decoded pixel depth and color space when available and printing or saving the full image as PDF
HEIC / HEIF support on Android 9 or later and AVIF support on Android 12 or later, backed by real decoder capability probes and clear unsupported-format messages
Tiled viewing for huge JPEG / PNG and static HEIC / HEIF images, using a bounded preview and high-resolution tiles for the visible region within a capped memory budget
improvement: Hardened every entry path with strict explorer-action v12 request, target, content, size and direct-child validation while retaining temporary read-only access and no storage or network permissions
Expanded the localized interface and user documentation in 10 languages, including a five-image gallery captured from the real Android UI
dependency: Added AndroidX ExifInterface 1.4.2 for read-only EXIF metadata parsing

fix: Enabling the plugin in the AutoJs6 plugin center failed because the service returned an empty binding (onNullBinding)
improvement: Leaner plugin name and description with consistent wording across all language documents

feature: First release of Image Viewer: a `View image` primary action for the AutoJs6 file manager, opening supported image files in a dedicated viewer with a single tap
Support for 8 extensions, BMP / GIF / JFIF / JPE / JPEG / JPG / PNG / WEBP, decoded by Android and Glide, with animated GIFs playing automatically
Viewer with fit-to-screen display, focal pinch zoom up to 5x, one-finger panning, double-tap restore, and tap-to-hide controls
File name in the title bar, MIME type, file size, and decoded resolution in the information bar, plus `Reset zoom`, `Share`, and `Open with another app` actions (excluding the plugin itself)

Isolated file manager and external `ACTION_VIEW` entries, both gated by temporary read-only content URI grants and item-by-item validation, with an 8 TiB per-file cap and no storage or network permissions
Plugin service registered on explorer-action protocol version 2, requiring host build 5269 or later
Plugin metadata, UI, instructions, and documents in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong / Taiwan), English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Arabic
dependency: Introduced Glide 5.0.5 as the image decoding and rendering engine
